name: Device List Table Widget v1
description: Desktop list/table view of devices with configurable columns (driven by the widget's Data keys), click-to-sort headers, search, and search/sort state persisted across dashboard state navigation. Each column's cell rendering can be customized via the data key's Advanced settings (same pattern as the standard Entities Table widget): displayAsStatusDot, align, columnWidth, sortable, useCellContentFunction/cellContentFunction, useCellStyleFunction/cellStyleFunction.
